name: Tender Breeze
source:
Main character reunites with his former lover Kotomi after a gap of four years. But she is now his brothers's fiance! In order to forget about Kotomi, protagonist tries to pursue romantic relations either with his childhood friend or part-time job colleague. Who will be at his side by the end of the summer?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-september-2004-abandoner.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公与昔日恋人琴美阔别四年后重逢，可她如今竟是自己哥哥的未婚妻！为了忘掉琴美，他尝试与青梅竹马或兼职同事发展恋爱关系。夏天结束时，陪在他身边的会是谁？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-september-2004-abandoner.html]vndbreview[/url]]
